newsitem.title: HONG KONG: GITIC says optimistic on Hualing's growth.
newsitem.headline: GITIC says optimistic on Hualing's growth.

text.p: Guangzhou International Trust & Investment Corp (GITIC) said it was optimistic about earnings growth at Hualing Holdings Ltd due to a recovery in purchasing power in China.
"We are positive on its earnings growth and our strategy is to support and enhance the growth of Chinese enterprises," GITIC chairman Xu Zhi told reporters on Tuesday.

GITIC has said it will make a cash offer for Hualing at HK$0.80 a share. "We seen keen competition in the home appliances market in China and we decided to make use of our strong financial strength to support its growth," Xu said.
When asked if GITIC intended to seek a Hong Kong listing through the takeover, Xu said: "Our aim was to support Hualing. Apart from that we did not have any other details planned."

GITIC's shareholding in the refrigerator manufacturer rose to 37.49 percent from 17.10 percent following a HK$152 million rights shares issue in September. GITIC had a stake of just over 10 percent before raising it to 17.10 percent in June, Xu said.

Of the HK$148 million in net proceeds raised from the rights issue, HK$58 million would be used towards financing Hualing's investment in its 50 percent-owned compressors maker Xian Dongling Refrigerating Compressor Co Ltd, said Xu.
Some HK$39 million would be used to fund the third phase expansion of its China Refrigeration Co Ltd and the balance would be for working capital.

"We are trying to increase production capacity to meet the anticipated demand for home appliances due to a recovery in the Chinese economy and signs of a pick up in purchasing power," said Hualing chairman Bi Qing.
